==Description==
'''Marcellius Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in the [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 24 on the premium track. It had a cost of {{GumDrops|625}} or {{Robux|87}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|6,895}} or {{Robux|1,450}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|109}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{Robux|1,825}}.

==Appearance==
'''Marcellius Charm''' appearance is based on one of the [[Children of Exo]], [[Marcellus]]. It has [[Marcellus]] standing on a platform with a few spikes coming out of it. It is pointing its Gatling Gun at something, preparing to fire. Black and purple smoke comes out of the charm.

The color of '''Marcellius Charm''' depends on the username color of the player in the chat, though it is purple in its inventory preview.

==Trivia==
*The name of the charm is actually misspelled, as [[Children of Exo#Marcellus & Kronus|Marcellus]] is not called ''Marcellius''.
